name: BlackHole agent end-to-end task corpus
description: Problem-only coding tasks for measuring full agent-loop solve-rate. Deterministic baseline uses operations; --real-model asks the configured model to solve from the instruction only.

cases.instruction: Fix average([]) so it returns 0 instead of NaN while preserving normal averages.
Make normalizeEmail trim whitespace and lowercase email addresses.
Fix parsePort so invalid, empty, non-integer, or non-positive values fall back to the provided default port.

operations.replace:
const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isInteger(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : defaultPort;

cases.instruction: Make uniqueTags return lowercase tags without duplicates while preserving first-seen order.
Fix loadUser so it returns a cached user without calling the fetcher again.
Rename the public formatter from formatName to formatDisplayName and update its test/import usage.
Make safeJsonParse return the fallback value when parsing invalid JSON.
Fix sortTasks so highest priority tasks appear first, with stable alphabetical tie-breaking.
Fix clamp so it respects both min and max boundaries.
Normalize punctuation and duplicate separators in toSlug.
Make formatStatus wrap uppercase statuses in square brackets.
Make sumValues coerce numeric strings while ignoring invalid values.
Support yes/no and 1/0 strings in parseBoolean.
Make ensureArray return an empty array for nullish input.

operations.replace:
if (value === null || value === undefined) return [];
  return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];

cases.instruction: Make lastItem return null for empty arrays.
Implement groupByCategory so items are grouped by category.
Make mergeDefaults keep explicit config values while filling missing defaults.
Make parseCsv trim entries and drop empty fields.
Make activeUsers return only users with active === true.
Make dollarsToCents round to the nearest cent.
Make titleCase capitalize each word and normalize whitespace.
Make redactToken keep the first and last four characters only.
Make parseQuery decode URL query strings into an object.
Make joinUrl avoid duplicate slashes between base and path.
Make summarizeNumbers return min, max, and count.

operations.replace: return { min: Math.min(...values), max: Math.max(...values), count: values.length };

cases.instruction: Make dedupeById preserve the first object for each id.
Make countWords ignore repeated whitespace and empty input.

operations.replace:
const text = String(value).trim();
  return text ? text.split(/\s+/).length : 0;

cases.instruction: Make normalizePath convert Windows separators to forward slashes.
Make isEven return true only for finite even numbers.

operations.replace:
const number = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(number) && number % 2 === 0;

cases.instruction: Make canAccess allow admins regardless of ownership.
Make paginate clamp page and size to positive values.

operations.search:
const start = (page - 1) * size;
  return items.slice(start, start + size);

cases.instruction: Make applyDiscount apply a percentage and round to two decimals.
Make invertObject swap keys and values as strings.
Make compactObject remove null and undefined values only.

operations.replace: return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).filter(([, val]) => val !== null && val !== undefined));

cases.instruction: Make shouldRetry allow attempts below maxRetries only.
Make getEnv return fallback when value is missing or empty.

operations.replace:
const value = env[key];
  return value === undefined || value === "" ? fallback : value;

cases.instruction: Make normalizeMethod uppercase methods and default to GET.
Make primaryEmail pick the primary email or fallback to the first email.

operations.replace:
const primary = user.emails.find(email => email.primary) || user.emails[0];
  return primary?.value || "";

cases.instruction: Make parseNumberList return only finite numbers from a comma string.
Make isOkStatus accept every 2xx HTTP status.
Make ensureExtension append the extension only when missing.
Make seededId produce a stable id prefix from a name.
Make hasRequiredFields check all requested fields are present.
Make mergeUnique combine arrays without duplicate primitive values.
Make durationMs return non-negative elapsed milliseconds.
Make formatBytes show bytes and KB values.

operations.replace:
const value = Number(bytes);
  return value < 1024 ? value + " B" : Math.round(value / 1024) + " KB";

cases.instruction: Make cacheKey sort object keys for stable cache keys.
Make findById match ids as strings.
Make normalizeLevel map unknown log levels to info.
Make extractDomain return the hostname from a URL.
